description: This file contains unit tests for heterogeneous silo configurations and grain resolver behaviors in an Orleans-based distributed application. It defines test classes, cluster setup/configuration, and multiple test methods to validate grain placement, exclusion, and resolver merging scenarios.

classes.name: HeterogeneousTests
classes.description: Test suite for heterogeneous silo configurations, including grain exclusion, type resolution merging, and placement strategies.

classes.name: SiloConfigurator
classes.description: Configures silo services, particularly for type management and placement strategies, based on host configuration.

classes.name: ClientConfigurator
classes.description: Configures client-side options, mainly the type map refresh interval.

methods.name: SetupAndDeployCluster
methods.description: Sets up a test cluster with specified placement strategy and blacklisted grain types.

methods.name: GrainExcludedTest
methods.description: Verifies grain exclusion by configuration, ensuring excluded grains cannot be resolved.

methods.name: MergeGrainResolverTests
methods.description: Tests merging grain resolvers with various placement strategies.

methods.name: MergeGrainResolverWithClientRefreshTests
methods.description: Tests resolver merging behavior with client refresh scenarios.

methods.name: CallITestGrainMethod
methods.description: Calls SetLabel method on ITestGrain instances.

methods.name: MergeGrainResolverTestsImpl
methods.description: Core implementation for resolver merge tests, managing cluster restart, silo addition/removal, and validation.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Async initialization method, currently a no-op.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Async cleanup method to stop silos and dispose cluster resources.
